title: Admin clean-up, Security section and Public Profiles
summary: Admin menu regrouped into People, Security, Modules, Communication and System; Security adds overview, audit log, Access, Keys and secrets and sign-in policy; Public Profiles lists profile-only people separately.
changes: Regroup the Admin menu: People (Public Accounts, Public Profiles, Staff Accounts), Security, Modules, Communication and System; Access leaves People.
Add Admin → Security with overview counts, a filterable audit log (audited export, no secrets), Access, Keys and secrets, and Sign-in policy.
Move Keys and secrets from Settings into Security; Settings keeps General, Integrations, Push, API clients, Webhooks and API docs.
Add Admin → Public Profiles for profile-only records, with shared hub editing and profile-only accounts kept out of Public Accounts.
Add admin.security.view/manage and admin.public-profiles.view/manage permissions; old Admin URLs redirect; Ctrl K finds the moved pages.
Update the Admin guide, wiki and secrets inventory for the new sections.
affected_areas: Admin → Security (overview, audit log, Access, Keys and secrets, Sign-in policy)
Admin → Public Profiles and Public Accounts
version_rationale: MINOR: new Security section and Public Profiles Admin area with menu regrouping; no breaking public API.
validation: PHPUnit Admin shell/navigation, Security overview/audit, Public Profiles, permissions, redirects and StaffHelpPagesTest.
Herd preview at https://myapes-account.test for Admin menu and Security pages.
composer milestone:bump -- v0.80.0 --check and myapes:changelog-validate against origin/main.
known_limitations: Embed forms stay under System until the Forms hub (v0.83.0).
API clients and Webhooks pages remain under Settings; Security links to them only.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release tag (v0.79.0). Permission rows for admin.security.* and admin.public-profiles.* can remain.
provenance: Milestone v0.80.0 Admin clean-up, Security section and Public Profiles, Epic #868, pull request #1073.
